rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Ship Investment Company Act and its Enforcement Decree , as well as matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended Dec. 28, 2005>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Ship Investment Company Act and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended Dec. 28, 2005>

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Application for Authorization of Ship Investment Business) ① Any person who intends to obtain authorization for a ship investment business pursuant to the provisions of Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Ship Investment Company Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)shall prepare an application for authorization containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs and submit it to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Dec. 28, 2005; Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jan. 2, 2017>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Authorization of Ship Investment Business) ① Any person who intends to obtain authorization for a ship investment business pursuant to Article 13(1) of the Ship Investment Company Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall prepare an application for authorization containing the matters specified in each of the following subparagraphs and submit it to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Dec. 28, 2005; Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jan. 2, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. Company Name
rows.text_en: 1. Company Name

rows.source_ko: 2. Location of the head office
rows.text_en: 2. Location of the head office

rows.source_ko: 3. Name, date of birth, and address of officers
rows.text_en: 3. Name, date of birth, and address of officers

rows.source_ko: 4. Matters concerning capital
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning capital

rows.source_ko: 5. Specifications of the vessel, such as name and gross tonnage
rows.text_en: 5. Specifications of the vessel, such as name and gross tonnage

rows.source_ko: ② The application for authorization under the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by the following documents:
rows.text_en: ② The application for authorization under the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by the following documents:

rows.source_ko: 1. Articles of Incorporation
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. Minutes of the Inaugural General Meeting
rows.text_en: 2. Minutes of the Inaugural General Meeting

rows.source_ko: 3. Documents regarding the executive's career
rows.text_en: 3. Documents regarding the executive's career

rows.source_ko: 4. Document proving payment of share capital
rows.text_en: 4. Document proving payment of share capital

rows.source_ko: 5. A written document stating the promoters' stock subscription record, the status of major shareholders, and the number of shares owned by them as of the application date.
rows.text_en: 5. A written document stating the promoters' stock subscription record, the status of major shareholders, and the number of shares owned by them as of the application date.

rows.source_ko: 6. Business Plan
rows.text_en: 6. Business Plan

rows.source_ko: 7. Copy of the contract regarding the entrustment of business with the ship management company and the asset custody company
rows.text_en: 7. Copy of the contract regarding the entrustment of business with the ship management company and the asset custody company

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Public Notice of Approval for Ship Investment Business) When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries has granted approval for a ship investment business pursuant to the provisions of Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act, he/she shall, without delay, publish the details in the Official Gazette and notify the general public using computer communication. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Public Notice of Approval for Ship Investment Business) When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries has granted approval for a ship investment business pursuant to the provisions of Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act, he/she shall, without delay, publish the details in the Official Gazette and notify the general public using computer communication. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Standards for Preparation and Contents of Settlement Documents, etc.) The standards for preparation and contents of settlement documents of a ship investment company pursuant to Article 38 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Corporate Accounting Standards pursuant to Article 13 of the Act on External Audits of Joint Stock Companies . However, settlement documents shall be prepared so as to allow for distribution up to the greater of the amount obtained by adding the amounts in Items 1 through 5 below and subtracting the amounts in Items 6 through 9 from the net profit or loss for the current period on the settlement documents of the ship investment company, and the distributable profit under the Commercial Act.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Standards for Preparation and Contents of Settlement Documents, etc.) The standards for preparation and contents of settlement documents of a ship investment company pursuant to Article 38 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Corporate Accounting Standards pursuant to Article 13 of the Act on External Audits of Joint Stock Companies . However, settlement documents shall be prepared so as to allow for distribution up to the greater of the amount obtained by adding the amounts in Items 1 through 5 below and subtracting the amounts in Items 6 through 9 from the net profit or loss for the current period on the settlement documents of the ship investment company, and the distributable profit under the Commercial Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. Depreciation of Tangible Assets
rows.text_en: 1. Depreciation of Tangible Assets

rows.source_ko: 2. Foreign exchange translation loss
rows.text_en: 2. Foreign exchange translation loss

rows.source_ko: 3. Expenses that reduce net income without a net cash loss, other than those in Items 1 and 2
rows.text_en: 3. Expenses that reduce net income without a net cash loss, other than those in Items 1 and 2

rows.source_ko: 4. Financial lease receivable recovery amount
rows.text_en: 4. Financial lease receivable recovery amount

rows.source_ko: 5. Decrease in assets or increase in liabilities resulting from operating activities
rows.text_en: 5. Decrease in assets or increase in liabilities resulting from operating activities

rows.source_ko: 6. Repayment of principal on borrowings
rows.text_en: 6. Repayment of principal on borrowings

rows.source_ko: 7. Foreign currency translation gains

rows.source_ko: 8. Revenue that increases net income without cash inflow, other than Items 6 and 7
rows.text_en: 8. Revenue that increases net income without cash inflow, other than Items 6 and 7

rows.source_ko: 9. Increase in assets or decrease in liabilities resulting from operating activities

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Matters to be Included in the Audit Report) The auditorshall include the following matters in the audit report pursuant to the provisions of Article 39 of the Act and sign and seal it.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Matters to be Included in the Audit Report) The auditor shall include the following matters in the audit report pursuant to Article 39 of the Act and sign and seal it.

rows.source_ko: 1. Overview of Audit Methods
rows.text_en: 1. Overview of Audit Methods

rows.source_ko: 2. In cases where matters required to be recorded in the accounting books are not recorded or are recorded inaccurately, or where the entries in the balance sheet or income statement do not correspond to the entries in the accounting books
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where matters required to be recorded in the accounting books are not recorded or are recorded inaccurately, or where the entries in the balance sheet or income statement do not correspond to the entries in the accounting books

rows.source_ko: 3. Whether the settlement documents accurately represent the assets and profit and loss status of the ship investment company in accordance with laws and regulations and the articles of incorporation
rows.text_en: 3. Whether the settlement documents accurately represent the assets and profit and loss status of the ship investment company in accordance with laws and regulations and the articles of incorporation

rows.source_ko: 4. Appropriateness of the change in accounting policy regarding the preparation of settlement documents
rows.text_en: 4. Appropriateness of the change in accounting policy regarding the preparation of settlement documents

rows.source_ko: 5. In the event that there is an improper act or a serious fact violating laws or the provisions of the Articles of Incorporation regarding the performance of a director's duties, such fact
rows.text_en: 5. In the event that there is an improper act or a serious fact violating laws or the provisions of the Articles of Incorporation regarding the performance of a director's duties, such fact

rows.source_ko: 6. In the event that there was an obstacle to an investigation necessary for an audit, that intention
rows.text_en: 6. In the event that there was an obstacle to an investigation necessary for an audit, that intention

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Procedures for Collection of Administrative Fines) The Enforcement Rules of the National Treasury Management Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the procedures for the collection of administrative fines pursuant to the provisions of Article 26, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree. In this case, the notice of payment shall also include the method of objection and the period for objection, etc. <Amended Dec. 28, 2005>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Procedures for Collection of Administrative Fines) The Enforcement Rules of the National Treasury Management Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the procedures for the collection of administrative fines pursuant to the provisions of Article 26, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree. In this case, the notice of payment shall also include the method of objection and the period for objection, etc. <Amended Dec. 28, 2005>
